mission: UNC13A post-deficit functional rescue evidence benchmark
scope: Abstract-only evidence; intentionally contains wrong or overreaching claims; not 20 independent papers

sources.related_work: Keuss Nature accepted 2026: do not count as independent replication

notes: 20 claim-level controls drawn from eight independently identified PubMed records, NOT a 20-paper review.
Insufficient means not justified by the abstract, not proven false in the universe of evidence.
Preprints may later be peer-reviewed: do not double count versions of the same experiment.
For temporal conclusions compare full protocols; abstract-only evidence is inadequate.
Labels were authored from public source summaries and need independent curator confirmation.
